587-2226-2499.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
587-2226-2499.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sawtooth Loon by paying its mana cost.
When Sawtooth Loon enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand, draw four cards, and put four cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

2023-4518-4885-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4694-5805-6798-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5805-6798-7306.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-2073-5315-7880.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Elven Bow from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Elven Bow enters, it triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token and attach Elven Bow to it.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Elven Bow.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
When the Elf Warrior dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

855-2021-2060-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
855-2021-2060-7803.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

789-1580-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-2946-4556-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
997-2946-4556-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4423-4872-6886-7705.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
4423-4872-6886-7705.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

1368-4927-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4927-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

628-2292-7191.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bristlebane Battler.
When Bristlebane Battler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

2906-4955-7070.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-4955-7070.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Grafted Wargear ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat.

339-677-6797-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2228-2665-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Progenitor Mimic.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Progenitor Mimic by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1062-3365-3487-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-3365-3487-5674.description:
Activate Aeromoeba by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Aeromoeba ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

360-2919-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
360-2919-3490-4050.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve all but one Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the last Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

141-4499-4739.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
141-4499-4739.description:
Cast Battle Hymn by paying {1}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Battle Hymn.
Resolve the copy of Battle Hymn, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control four or more creatures, this combo nets infinite red mana.

1355-1455-4124-5295.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, targeting Sanctum Weaver.
Vesuvan Duplimancy triggers, creating a token copy of Sanctum Weaver.
Activate the Sanctum Weaver token by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other creature you control to get infinite nonlegendary copies of that creature.
